title: User can sign in and view order history
description: As a registered customer I want to sign in and see my recent orders so I can track deliveries.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Valid email and password signs the user in and lands on Home. AC2: Invalid password shows an error and does not navigate away. AC3: Authenticated user can open Order History and see at least order id and status. AC4: Sign-out returns the user to the sign-in page.
acceptanceCriteriaList: AC1: Valid email and password signs the user in and lands on Home.
AC2: Invalid password shows an error and does not navigate away.
AC3: Authenticated user can open Order History and see at least order id and status.
AC4: Sign-out returns the user to the sign-in page.
